newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: COLONIAL TRUST PLANS 1 FOR 2 RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: COLONIAL TRUST PLANS 1 FOR 2 RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Colonial Industrial Property Trust announced on Tuesday the acquisition of four industrial properties and a one for two renounceable rights issue to raise A$74.3 million to pay for the purchases.
The units are to be issued at A$1.88 each, with 80 cents payable on application and A$1.08 payable on July 1, 1998.
The issue is being underwritten by SBC Warburg Australia Ltd.
Colonial's units were up two cents at A$2.00 at 11.45 a.m. (0145 GMT).

Colonial said the manager of the trust was forecasting distributions to new unitholders of A$1.83 cents per unit for the quarter ending December 1997 and 12.54 cents per unit for the twelve months to December 1998.
This represented an annualised yield of about 9.15 percent and 9.35 percent per annum respectively, it said.
"On completion of the acquisitions, construction of the buildings and capital raising the trust will have total assets of approximately A$250 million," it said.
